title: Days
persona:
- Age and background: 33. Ghana; Kumasi community radio editor. Plays chess weekly with a friend and occasional mobile puzzles; little video-game experience.
- HF temperament: no HF exposure and no recorded temperament. Treat him as a person who weighs concrete likes against concrete limits, and who says what he saw in play in his own words.
- Likes: seeing what each move changes before he commits to the next, thinking time that nothing interrupts, ordering and trimming material until it fits, plain sentences that say what an action does.
- Dislikes: pressure to act before he has read the screen, buttons whose result he cannot predict, game jargon that is not explained where it appears, being asked for accounts or permissions without a visible reason.
- Play habits: Plays chess with a friend once a week, on a board or a phone, and mobile puzzles in spare minutes. Edits audio at a desktop at work. Reads the whole screen, thinks, then makes one move and checks the result. Says plainly when something does not suit him.
- Personal diary: empty. No play history of any kind. Only observed sessions can add history.
